description: Multiplicative adjustments applied to base-rate LOA for each modality. Established modalities use point estimates inside published BIO/Informa ranges; range_low/range_high preserve the documented uncertainty. v1.1 adds frontier modalities (targeted protein degrader, radiopharmaceutical, epigenetic editing) that predate any BIO/Informa cohort — these are explicitly labelled as Asclepius estimates with their reasoning, never attributed to BIO/Informa. The `source` field is self-describing and rendered verbatim in the PoS audit trail.

multipliers.rationale: Reference modality. Most BIO/Informa base rates are computed on a small-molecule-dominant historical cohort.
mAbs show higher Phase 1 safety and lower attrition through approval; biologics LOA from P1 reported ~11% vs ~6% for NMEs.
ADCs face higher CMC and DLT/payload-toxicity attrition relative to naked antibodies; manufacturing complexity raises late-stage risk.
multipliers.source: Informa Pharma Intelligence modality attrition data

multipliers.rationale: Gene therapies show elevated Phase 3 attrition (durability, immunogenicity, dose-response); CMC scale-up risk also significant.
multipliers.source: Informa Pharma Intelligence modality attrition data

multipliers.rationale: Autologous cell therapies face per-patient manufacturing variability and complex logistics; documented higher commercial-stage attrition.
multipliers.source: Informa Pharma Intelligence modality attrition data

multipliers.rationale: Allogeneic platforms simplify supply but face persistence and immunogenicity risk.
multipliers.source: Informa Pharma Intelligence modality attrition data

multipliers.rationale: Platform validated for vaccines; therapeutic mRNA still has limited Phase 3 readouts outside infectious disease.
multipliers.source: Informa Pharma Intelligence modality attrition data

multipliers.rationale: Recombinant proteins/enzymes track biologics behavior with slight discount for immunogenicity risk.
ASO/siRNA approvals exist but historical Phase 2 attrition is high; delivery/biodistribution remains the dominant risk.
multipliers.source: Informa Pharma Intelligence modality attrition data

multipliers.rationale: Peptides behave like small molecules in success rates; PK/PD challenges offset structural simplicity.
multipliers.source: Informa Pharma Intelligence modality attrition data

multipliers.rationale: PROTAC / molecular-glue degraders inherit favorable oral small-molecule PK but their event-driven, catalytic pharmacology is unproven at approval (no FDA-approved degrader as of 2025). Ternary-complex optimization, hook effect, and durability of degradation add early-clinical risk that the small-molecule reference does not carry. Modest discount + a wide range reflect promising-but-unvalidated translation.
multipliers.source: Asclepius estimate (frontier modality; no BIO/Informa cohort — no approved degrader as of 2025; reasoned off oral-SM PK plus novel-MoA translation risk)

multipliers.rationale: Radioligand therapy is clinically validated with approvals (Lutathera 2018, Pluvicto 2022) and strong tumor targeting, so it does not warrant the deep discount of unproven modalities. The slight discount captures isotope-supply, dosimetry, and radiochemistry-CMC complexity — especially acute for short-half-life alpha emitters (Ac-225), where supply can gate both trials and commercialization.
multipliers.source: Asclepius estimate (anchored on approved radioligand therapies — Lutathera 2018, Pluvicto 2022 — with a manufacturing/supply-complexity discount)

multipliers.rationale: Epigenetic editors (e.g. CRISPR-based silencers/activators) are an early modality with no approvals. Durability of the epigenetic mark, delivery/biodistribution (typically LNP), off-target epigenome effects, and the possibility of re-dosing are major unknowns. Profile is closer to gene therapy than small molecule, with added durability uncertainty.
multipliers.source: Asclepius estimate (frontier modality; no approvals, no BIO/Informa cohort — reasoned off gene-therapy attrition plus epigenetic-durability and delivery uncertainty)

multipliers.rationale: Unspecified modality — defaults to reference; widen the range to reflect higher prior uncertainty.
